usageNotes: Use this to list all named IP sets defined in the cluster-level firewall configuration. Requires the Sys.Audit privilege on the root path (/). IP set names returned here are used as references in firewall rules via the '+setname' syntax, so enumerate them before creating or auditing firewall rules.

examples.summary: List all cluster firewall IP sets

tips: The digest field in each returned item can be passed to write operations to guard against concurrent modifications.
IP set names follow the pattern [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\-\_]+ — they must start with a letter and be at least 2 characters.
This endpoint lists cluster-level IP sets only; node or VM/CT firewall IP sets are managed under their respective paths.
